description: Synthetic sesslint.determinism parity vectors (hashes and structural fields only, no session payloads).
known_parity_gaps: NaN, Infinity: canonical_json_bytes rejects non-finite floats; Rust codec error text may differ from Python json module errors - do not assert message parity for these cases.
Lone surrogate in a JSON string: Python json may accept invalid Unicode; Rust canonical codec behavior may differ - not asserted here.
stable_sort_findings with a non-Finding item: Python raises TypeError; Rust only accepts Finding and does not model mixed lists.
JSON integers outside i64: Rust Value uses i64; very large integers are not represented in the Rust parity harness.
